$ cat docker-compose.yaml
services:
  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.4.7
    container_name: mysql-server
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}
      # 注意：以下变量已注释 → 不会自动创建数据库和普通用户
      # MYSQL_DATABASE: mydb
      # MYSQL_USER: user
      # MYSQL_PASSWORD: password
      MYSQL_ROOT_HOST: '%'  # ← 仅开发环境保留；生产环境请删除此行
    ports:
      - "3306:3306"
    volumes:
      - mysql-data:/var/lib/mysql
      - ./init:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d  # 放 .sql 或 .sh 初始化脚本
      - /etc/localtime:/etc/localtime:ro    # 同步宿主机时间
      - /etc/timezone:/etc/timezone:ro    # Ubuntu/Debian 可选，非必需
    networks:
      - mysql-network
    command: >
      --default-authentication-plugin=mysql_native_password
      --character-set-server=utf8mb4
      --collation-server=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
      --sql-mode=STRICT_TRANS_TABLES,NO_ZERO_DATE,ERROR_FOR_DIVISION_BY_ZERO,NO_ENGINE_SUBSTITUTION
      --explicit_defaults_for_timestamp=ON
    logging:
      driver: json-file
      options:
        max-size: "100m"
        max-file: "3"

volumes:
  mysql-data:
    driver: local

networks:
  mysql-network:
    driver: bridge

Docker 安装 gitlab-ce

将 gitlab 挂载到 /data/gitlab 目录下

# 创建目录并授权（GitLab 容器内 UID=1000）
sudo mkdir -p /data/gitlab/{config,logs,data}
sudo chown -R 1000:1000 /data/gitlab

/apps/docker_modules/gitlab-ce中保存了gitlab-ce的docker-compose.yaml文件

$ cat docker-compose.yaml
services:
  gitlab-ce:
    container_name: gitlab-ce
    image: gitlab/gitlab-ce:18.3.5-ce.0  # 避免 latest
    hostname: gitlab.xlwx.top
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      GITLAB_OMNIBUS_CONFIG: |
        # === 基础配置 ===
        external_url 'https://gitlab.xlwx.top'
        nginx['listen_port'] = 9080
        nginx['listen_addresses'] = ['*']
        nginx['listen_https'] = false

        # 告诉 GitLab：前端有反向代理，信任 X-Forwarded-* 头
        nginx['real_ip_trusted_addresses'] = ['127.0.0.1', '172.16.146.206']
        nginx['real_ip_header'] = 'X-Real-IP'
        nginx['real_ip_recursive'] = 'on'

        gitlab_rails['gitlab_shell_ssh_port'] = 9022
        gitlab_rails['initial_root_password'] = "${GITLAB_ROOT_PASSWORD}"

        # === 邮件配置 ===
        mailroom['enable'] = false
        gitlab_rails['smtp_enable'] = true
        gitlab_rails['smtp_address'] = "smtp.163.com"
        gitlab_rails['smtp_port'] = 465
        gitlab_rails['smtp_user_name'] = "${SMTP_USER}"
        gitlab_rails['smtp_password'] = "${SMTP_PASSWORD}"
        gitlab_rails['smtp_domain'] = "163.com"
        gitlab_rails['smtp_authentication'] = "login"
        gitlab_rails['smtp_tls'] = true
        gitlab_rails['smtp_enable_starttls_auto'] = false
        gitlab_rails['smtp_openssl_verify_mode'] = 'peer'
        gitlab_rails['gitlab_email_from'] = "${SMTP_USER}"
        gitlab_rails['gitlab_email_reply_to'] = "${SMTP_USER}"
        gitlab_rails['gitlab_email_display_name'] = 'VS GitLab Server'

        # === 性能优化（为 CI/CD 增强）===
        puma['worker_processes'] = 2
        puma['min_threads'] = 4
        puma['max_threads'] = 8
        sidekiq['max_concurrency'] = 15
        postgresql['shared_buffers'] = "256MB"
        nginx['worker_processes'] = 2

        # === 监控组件（兼容 GitLab 17+）===
        prometheus['enable'] = true
        prometheus_monitoring['enable'] = true
        node_exporter['enable'] = true
        redis_exporter['enable'] = true
        postgres_exporter['enable'] = true

        prometheus['listen_address'] = '0.0.0.0:19090'
        node_exporter['listen_address'] = '0.0.0.0:19100'
        redis_exporter['listen_address'] = '0.0.0.0:19121'
        postgres_exporter['listen_address'] = '0.0.0.0:19187'

        # === 精简非必要功能 ===
        gitlab_rails['usage_ping_enabled'] = false
        gitlab_rails['sentry_enabled'] = false
        gitlab_rails['auto_migrate'] = true
        gitlab_rails['rake_cache_clear'] = true

        # === 存储路径（默认即可，因已通过 volume 挂载）===
        gitlab_rails['repositories_storages'] = {
          "default" => {
            "path" => "/var/opt/gitlab/git-data/repositories",
            "gitaly_address" => "unix:/var/opt/gitlab/gitaly/gitaly.socket"
          }
        }
        gitlab_rails['uploads_directory'] = '/var/opt/gitlab/uploads'

        # === 日志与维护 ===
        logging['svlogd_size'] = 107374182  # 100MB
        logging['svlogd_num'] = 10          # 保留 10 个文件
        gitlab_rails['backup_keep_time'] = 2592000  # 30天
        gitlab_rails['time_zone'] = 'Asia/Shanghai'

    ports:
      - "9080:9080"    # Web UI
      - "9022:22"      # Git over SSH
      # 监控端口映射
      - "9090:19090"   # Prometheus
      - "9100:19100"   # Node Exporter
      - "9121:19121"   # Redis Exporter
      - "9187:19187"   # Postgres Exporter

    volumes:
      - /data/gitlab/config:/etc/gitlab
      - /data/gitlab/logs:/var/log/gitlab
      - /data/gitlab/data:/var/opt/gitlab

    shm_size: '256m'
    mem_limit: 12g
    mem_reservation: 4g
    cpus: 4

    # 可选：健康检查（取消注释启用）
    # healthcheck:
    #   test: ["CMD", "/opt/gitlab/bin/gitlab-healthcheck", "--fail"]
    #   interval: 30s
    #   timeout: 10s
    #   retries: 3
$ docker compose up

会下载镜像，然后启动，启动时间比较长（10分钟+）

前台启动没有问题，关闭后我们之间后台启动

$ docker compose up -d

nignx配置

cat gitlab.conf
#HTTPS使用SSL访问的配置
server {
     #SSL 默认访问端口号为 443
     listen 443 ssl;

     #请填写绑定证书的域名
     server_name gitlab.xlwx.top;

     #请填写证书文件的相对路径或绝对路径
     ssl_certificate /usr/cert/gitlab/gitlab.xlwx.top.pem;

     #请填写私钥文件的相对路径或绝对路径
     ssl_certificate_key /usr/cert/gitlab/gitlab.xlwx.top.key;

     #缓存SSL握手产生的参数和加密密钥的时长
     ssl_session_timeout 5m;

     #请按照以下协议配置
     ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

     #请按照以下套件配置，配置加密套件，写法遵循 openssl 标准。
     ssl_ciphers ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5:!RC4:!DHE;
     #ssl_ciphers ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE:ECDH:AES:HIGH:!NULL:!aNULL:!MD5:!ADH:!RC4;

     #加密套件优先选择服务器的加密套件
     ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;

     # --- 安全头 ---
     add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always;
     add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff;
     add_header X-Frame-Options DENY;
     add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin";

     # --- 反向代理核心配置 ---
     location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:9080;  # 转发到 GitLab 容器

        # 传递原始请求信息
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;  # 告诉 GitLab 是 HTTPS
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Ssl on;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_http_version 1.1;

        # 关键：禁用缓冲和缓存（GitLab 要求）
        proxy_cache off;
        proxy_request_buffering off;
        proxy_redirect off;

        # 超时设置（避免大文件上传失败）
        proxy_connect_timeout 300s;
        proxy_send_timeout 300s;
        proxy_read_timeout 300s;
    }
}
#HTTP 自动跳转 HTTPS 的安全配置
server {
     listen 80;
     #请填写绑定证书的域名
     server_name gitlab.xlwx.top;
     #把http的域名请求转成https
     return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}

访问https://gitlab.xlwx.top就可以了

services:
  nacos:
    image: nacos/nacos-server:${NACOS_VERSION}
    container_name: nacos-standalone
    environment:
      - PREFER_HOST_MODE=hostname
      - MODE=standalone
      - NACOS_AUTH_IDENTITY_KEY=serverIdentity
      - NACOS_AUTH_IDENTITY_VALUE=security
      - NACOS_AUTH_TOKEN=VGhpc0lzTXlDdXN0b21TZWNyZXRLZXkwMTIzNDU2Nzg=
    volumes:
      - ./standalone-logs/:/home/nacos/logs
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
      - "8848:8848"
      - "9848:9848"
  prometheus:
    container_name: prometheus
    image: prom/prometheus:latest
    volumes:
      - ./prometheus/prometheus-standalone.yaml:/etc/prometheus/prometheus.yml
    ports:
      - "9090:9090"
    depends_on:
      - nacos
    restart: on-failure
  grafana:
    container_name: grafana
    image: grafana/grafana:latest
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    restart: on-failure

后续还可以给nacos配置一个域名，然后通过域名访问，就不用显示的数据8848端口了。

cat nacos.conf
#HTTPS使用SSL访问的配置
server {
     #SSL 默认访问端口号为 443
     listen 443 ssl;

     #请填写绑定证书的域名
     server_name <你的域名>;

     #请填写证书文件的相对路径或绝对路径
     ssl_certificate /usr/cert/nacos/<你的域名>.pem;

     #请填写私钥文件的相对路径或绝对路径
     ssl_certificate_key /usr/cert/nacos/<你的域名>.key;

     #缓存SSL握手产生的参数和加密密钥的时长
     ssl_session_timeout 5m;

     #请按照以下协议配置
     ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

     #请按照以下套件配置，配置加密套件，写法遵循 openssl 标准。
     ssl_ciphers ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5:!RC4:!DHE;
     #ssl_ciphers ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE:ECDH:AES:HIGH:!NULL:!aNULL:!MD5:!ADH:!RC4;

     #加密套件优先选择服务器的加密套件
     ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;

     # --- 安全头 ---
     add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always;
     add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff;
     add_header X-Frame-Options DENY;
     add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin";

     # --- 反向代理核心配置 ---
     location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8080;  # 转发到 Nacos 容器

        # 传递原始请求信息
        proxy_set_header Host $http_host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;  # 告诉 Nacos 是 HTTPS
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Ssl on;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_http_version 1.1;

        # 关键：禁用缓冲和缓存（GitLab 要求）
        proxy_cache off;
        proxy_request_buffering off;
        proxy_redirect off;

        # 超时设置（避免大文件上传失败）
        proxy_connect_timeout 300s;
        proxy_send_timeout 300s;
        proxy_read_timeout 300s;
    }
}
#HTTP 自动跳转 HTTPS 的安全配置
server {
     listen 80;
     #请填写绑定证书的域名
     server_name <你的域名>;
     #把http的域名请求转成https
     return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}

[root@iZwz968l7cazo3lhnqenz2Z vector_draft]# cat deploy.sh
#!/bin/bash

# ==============================
# 应用配置
# ==============================
AppName=vectordraft-backend.jar  # JAR 文件名

# JVM 参数（根据实际需求调整）
JVM_OPTS="-Dname=$AppName -Duser.timezone=Asia/Shanghai -Xms512m -Xmx512m -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:MetaspaceSize=128m -XX:MaxMetaspaceSize=256m"

# ==============================
# 脚本内部变量（一般无需修改）
# ==============================
APP_HOME=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")"; pwd)
LOG_DIR=$APP_HOME/logs
LOG_FILE=$LOG_DIR/${AppName%.jar}.log
PID_FILE=$LOG_DIR/${AppName%.jar}.pid

# 创建日志目录
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"

# 检查操作参数
if [ "$1" = "" ]; then
    echo -e "\033[0;31m 未输入操作名 \033[0m  \033[0;34m {start|stop|restart|status} \033[0m"
    exit 1
fi

# 检查 JAR 文件是否存在
if [ ! -f "$APP_HOME/$AppName" ]; then
    echo -e "\033[0;31m 错误：JAR 文件不存在！\033[0m 请确认 $APP_HOME/$AppName 存在。"
    exit 1
fi

# 获取当前应用 PID
get_pid() {
    if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then
        PID=$(cat "$PID_FILE")
        # 验证 PID 是否仍在运行且属于本应用
        if ps -p "$PID" > /dev/null 2>&1 && ps -p "$PID" -o args= | grep -q "$AppName"; then
            echo "$PID"
        else
            rm -f "$PID_FILE"  # 清理无效 PID 文件
            echo ""
        fi
    else
        # 兜底：通过进程命令查找（兼容旧方式）
        ps -ef | grep "java" | grep "$AppName" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}' | head -n1
    fi
}

# 启动函数
start() {
    local PID=$(get_pid)
    if [ -n "$PID" ]; then
        echo "$AppName is already running (PID: $PID)"
        return 0
    fi

    echo "Starting $AppName ..."

    # 启动命令（不使用 Spring 参数）
    nohup java $JVM_OPTS -jar "$APP_HOME/$AppName" >> "$LOG_FILE" 2>&1 &
    echo $! > "$PID_FILE"  # 保存 PID 到文件，更可靠

    sleep 1
    if [ -f "$PID_FILE" ] && ps -p $(cat "$PID_FILE") > /dev/null; then
        echo "Start $AppName success (PID: $(cat "$PID_FILE"))"
        echo "Log file: $LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo -e "\033[0;31m Failed to start $AppName \033[0m"
        rm -f "$PID_FILE"
    fi
}

# 停止函数
stop() {
    local PID=$(get_pid)
    if [ -z "$PID" ]; then
        echo "$AppName is not running"
        return 0
    fi

    echo "Stopping $AppName (PID: $PID) ..."
    kill "$PID" 2>/dev/null

    local count=0
    while [ $count -lt 30 ]; do
        if ! ps -p "$PID" > /dev/null; then
            echo "$AppName stopped."
            rm -f "$PID_FILE"
            return 0
        fi
        sleep 1
        ((count++))
    done

    echo "Timeout! Force killing $AppName ..."
    kill -9 "$PID" 2>/dev/null
    rm -f "$PID_FILE"
}

# 重启函数
restart() {
    stop
    sleep 2
    start
}

# 状态函数
status() {
    local PID=$(get_pid)
    if [ -n "$PID" ]; then
        echo "$AppName is running (PID: $PID)"
    else
        echo "$AppName is not running"
    fi
}

# 主逻辑
case "$1" in
    start)
        start
        ;;
    stop)
        stop
        ;;
    restart)
        restart
        ;;
    status)
        status
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Usage: $0 {start|stop|restart|status}"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

nginx 配置

cat vectordraft.conf
#HTTPS使用SSL访问的配置
server {
     #SSL 默认访问端口号为 443
     listen 443 ssl;

     #请填写绑定证书的域名
     server_name writing.xlwx.top;

     #请填写证书文件的相对路径或绝对路径
     #ssl_certificate /usr/cert/api.tdytech.cn_bundle.pem;

     #请填写私钥文件的相对路径或绝对路径
     #ssl_certificate_key /usr/cert/api.tdytech.cn.key;

     #缓存SSL握手产生的参数和加密密钥的时长
     #ssl_session_timeout 5m;

     #请按照以下协议配置
     #ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;

     #请按照以下套件配置，配置加密套件，写法遵循 openssl 标准。
     #ssl_ciphers ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5:!RC4:!DHE;
     ##ssl_ciphers ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE:ECDH:AES:HIGH:!NULL:!aNULL:!MD5:!ADH:!RC4;

     #加密套件优先选择服务器的加密套件
     #ssl_prefer_server_ciphers on;

     # 服务
     location /api/ {
	proxy_pass http://localhost:9040/;
        # 设置代理的基本头信息
	proxy_set_header Host paba-dev.qutke.cn;
        #proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        # 转发客户端的 Authorization 头
        proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;

        # 关闭默认的重定向处理
        proxy_redirect off;

        # 可选：设置超时
        proxy_connect_timeout 30s;
        proxy_send_timeout 30s;
        proxy_read_timeout 30s;
    }

     # WEB配置
     location / {
         #网站主页路径。此路径仅供参考，具体请您按照实际目录操作。
         #例如，您的网站主页在 Nginx 服务器的 /etc/www 目录下，则请修改 root 后面的 html 为 /etc/www。
         root /apps/web_modules/vector_draft/dist; ###配置主应用的文件夹
         index index.html index.htm;
         try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
     }
     #include conf.d/common.item;
}
#HTTP 自动跳转 HTTPS 的安全配置
server {
     listen 80;
     #请填写绑定证书的域名
     server_name writing.xlwx.top;
     #把http的域名请求转成https
     #return 301 https://$host$request_uri;

     # 服务
     location /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://localhost:9040/;
        # 设置代理的基本头信息
        proxy_set_header Host paba-dev.qutke.cn;
        #proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        # 转发客户端的 Authorization 头
        proxy_set_header Authorization $http_authorization;

        # 关闭默认的重定向处理
        proxy_redirect off;

        # 可选：设置超时
        proxy_connect_timeout 30s;
        proxy_send_timeout 30s;
        proxy_read_timeout 30s;
    }

     # WEB配置
     location / {
         #网站主页路径。此路径仅供参考，具体请您按照实际目录操作。
         #例如，您的网站主页在 Nginx 服务器的 /etc/www 目录下，则请修改 root 后面的 html 为 /etc/www。
         root /apps/web_modules/vector_draft/dist; ###配置主应用的文件夹
         index index.html index.htm;
         try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
     }
}

     }
     #include conf.d/common.item;
}
#HTTP 自动跳转 HTTPS 的安全配置
server {
     listen 80;
     #请填写绑定证书的域名
     server_name writing.xlwx.top;
     #把http的域名请求转成https
     return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}
